summary: Process switch `execution_planning` lets an execution plan write each fact once and review its contracts and topology in one pass. `per_document`, the default, keeps today's separate contract reviews and every compiler output. At `single_source_bundle`, `skill-content/execution-plan/data/fact-ownership.json` names the one owning document, section and writer of each execution-planning fact class, and `tools/validate.py` rejects a class with no owner, two owners, an unknown writer or a writer its owning flow does not name. The architect's planning output becomes a transient handoff to the contract writers; `delivery_compile.py bundle-manifest` lists every contract the plan revises, pins or still has to carry, every Item record with its Story and Test Plan and the fact ownership data with the hashes of their bytes, and the Delivery's `User Decisions` section, which owns every owner ruling, with the hash of its text; it names each revised contract's counterpart as a reader in the role name `task_inputs.py --role` takes and is recomputed with `--expected-hash` before a finding is accepted, so a changed ruling needs a fresh read. The bundle takes one review layer, or review panel `execution_bundle` at `review_panels` `lens_panel`, in place of each contract's separate counterpart review, and a contract revision that no Item pins stays in the manifest's `unpinned_revisions`, approval notwithstanding, until the Integration, or before reservation the target, holds it; it is recorded on the target branch and brought in with `refresh-target` before publication. The switch registry gains `value_data`: package data that only one switch value reads is bound with that value's switch references and never on the default path. `delivery_compile.py bundle-manifest` lists every revised or pinned contract, every Item record with its Story and Test Plan and the fact ownership and review panel lens data with the hashes of their bytes, names each revised contract's counterpart as a reader and is recomputed with `--expected-hash` before a finding is accepted.
